University of Edinburgh Robertson International Scholarship 2022 is an initiative of the School of History, Classics and Archaeology, the University of Edinburgh for undergraduate overseas applicants. The aim of this scholarship is to support the study of international students. A total of 5 scholarships are offered to the scholars. The selected students will receive GBP 1,000 for one year.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be a national of a country outside the UK
Be liable for the overseas rate of tuition fee

Have applied through the University and Colleges Admission Service (UCAS) to commence an undergraduate programme of study within the School of History, Classics and Archaeology for the 2022-2023 academic year
The selected scholars will receive GBP 1,000 for one year.
